shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js'; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "for f in pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'find app lib components -type f -print | sort && git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > tsconfig.json <<'EOF'
{
  \"compilerOptions\": {
    \"target\": \"ES2017\",
    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
    \"allowJs\": true,
    \"skipLibCheck\": true,
    \"strict\": true,
    \"noEmit\": true,
    \"esModuleInterop\": true,
    \"module\": \"esnext\",
    \"moduleResolution\": \"bundler\",
    \"resolveJsonModule\": true,
    \"isolatedModules\": true,
    \"jsx\": \"react-jsx\",
    \"incremental\": true,
    \"plugins\": [
      {
        \"name\": \"next\"
      }
    ],
    \"paths\": {
      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
    }
  },
  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\", \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"],
  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\", \"EVAL.ts\"]
}
EOF
cat >> .gitignore <<'EOF'
.next/
next-env.d.ts
*.tsbuildinfo
EOF
npx tsc --noEmit"

/bin/bash -lc 'test ! -e pages && printf '"'pages directory removed\\n' && rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getServerSideProps|getInitialProps' app components lib || true"
